"answer_phrase": "In summary, the next action I will perform is",

tool_call_format.note: Actions are bracketed command strings such as `click [id]` inside backticks, parsed from the text. cli_flags is the closest value, but the format is really a bracket-argument DSL, so this is an ambiguity.

tool_count.evidence_quote: `stop [answer]`: Issue this action when you believe the task is complete.
tool_count.note: Count of prompt-listed actions: click, type, hover, press, scroll, new_tab, tab_focus, close_tab, goto, go_back, go_forward, stop, check. Plus the decisions move/revise/request. These are not function schemas.

edit_primitive.note: The action list contains browser actions only, with no file-editing action.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: `click [id]`: This action clicks on an element with a specific id on the webpage.

protocol_standardization.note: Only the OpenAI client appears in the evidence. No MCP or A2A appears in the shipped files.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: If they align, proceed to the next phase and output the action decision as ```move```. If discrepancies arise, you have two options: 1) If you suspect issues with your local plan, output the action ```revise```
loop_primitives.note: The global plan is split into phases. The local plan is executed, then checked, then revised or replanned.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The global planning agent decomposes tasks into subtasks (“Phase 1, Phase 2 ... Phase N”) and assigns them to the local execution agent.
planning_granularity.note: GlobalPlanner.global_plan returns a parsed plan list, and LocalAgent.local_plan returns a parsed local plan.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Specifically, our CoAct framework involves two agents:
multi_agent_topology.note: Two-level global planner/local executor. The paper calls this hierarchical, but only two levels exist, so orchestrator_workers is closest.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Local execution agents can request adjustments to the global plan, enabling macro-level re-planning.
delegation_mechanism.note: Phases are passed from the GlobalPlanner to the LocalAgent within one run. The run loop (test_plan.py) is not in the bundle.
